tags.name: volunteers
tags.description: Qualifications, positions, membership, shifts and sign-ups.

get.summary: The catalogue: active entries to everyone; archived=true needs qualifications.manage.

post.summary: Add a catalogue entry. Org-wide needs qualifications.manage site-wide; a department's, at the department. 409 name taken, department archived.

put.summary: Change an entry. 400 scope when department differs; 409 archived, taken.

get.summary: A person's records: their own (with self_upload), or another's with qualifications.read/verify.

post.summary: A lead records a qualification as verified now. Needs qualifications.verify (org-wide: in any extent). 400 self, range, one_of (no_expiry with expires_on); 409 archived.
Upload a certificate: creates a pending record that counts only once a lead verifies it. 501 when self-upload is off; 409 pending_exists, archived.

get.summary: Pending records the caller may verify (qualifications.verify extent).

post.summary: Verify a pending record, optionally correcting the dates or clearing the expiry (no_expiry). The body may be empty. 400 self, one_of; 409 status.
Reject (delete) a pending record and its certificate. 409 status.

delete.summary: Remove a record: one's own pending one, or any with qualifications.verify.

get.summary: The certificate bytes for the person or a lead who may read the record (audited).
A department's positions with requirements; archived=true needs positions.manage.

post.summary: Add a position. Needs positions.manage at the department. 409 taken, archived.
Archive a position. 409 in_use (future shifts), archived.

put.summary: Replace the position's required qualifications. 400 too_many, duplicate, unknown, scope; 409 archived.

get.summary: A department's members with playa names and eligible positions, a page at a time. Needs rosters.read.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The next value of the previous page (opaque). Absent for the first page. 400 malformed when it is not one this list gave.

post.summary: Add a member. Needs members.manage. 400 unknown person; 409 duplicate, archived.

delete.summary: Remove a member. Needs members.manage. 404 not a member.
Leave a department; future bookings on its members-only positions are canceled.

get.summary: Shifts the caller may see, with booked, mine and eligibility, a page at a time (order starts; follow next). from or to alone is allowed. canceled=true or a past window needs shifts.manage/rosters.read. eligible=true keeps the shifts the caller can take or holds. 400 malformed after, canceled or eligible.

parameters.name: eligible
parameters.description: true: only the shifts the caller can take now and the ones they already hold. The rest are dropped after the fetch, so a page may be short or empty with next set; keep following next.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The next value of the previous page (opaque). Absent for the first page. 400 malformed when it is not one this list gave.

get.summary: One shift (404 when the caller may not see it); mates (playa names of the others booked) only when the regional's policy shows it.

put.summary: Change a shift. 404 when the caller may not see it, 403 when visible without shifts.manage. 400 scope on event (a shift's event never changes); 409 canceled, full, overlap, closed.

post.summary: Add a shift. Needs shifts.manage at the department. 409 archived, closed.
Cancel the shift and its bookings. 404 when the caller may not see it, 403 when visible without shifts.manage. 409 canceled.
Copy the department's shifts from one event to another (idempotent).
Book the caller. 404 when the shift is not visible. 409 unnamed (set a playa name first), canceled, started, archived, closed, not_member, unqualified (missing), full, overlap (shift), duplicate.
Book another person (or oneself); waive records a missing requirement. Needs shifts.manage. 404 when the shift is not visible. 409 as sign-up (unnamed included, whatever waive says), ended.

delete.summary: Cancel a booking: one's own (before the start and the cutoff) or any with shifts.manage. 409 status, started, cutoff.

get.summary: The roster with person IDs, playa names, waivers and eligibility; legal_name per the regional's policy. Needs rosters.read; 404 when the shift is not visible.

The caller's bookings, a page at a time. Upcoming (default): not ended, soonest first, with bookings someone else canceled shown until the shift ends. past=true: ended, booked only, newest first. 400 malformed after.

parameters.name: past
parameters.description: false (default): bookings whose shift has not ended, soonest first, with the ones someone else canceled until the shift ends. true: booked sign-ups whose shift has ended, newest first.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The next value of the previous page (opaque). Absent for the first page. 400 malformed when it is not one this list gave.

get.summary: Whether the caller's playa name is shown to others on their shifts.

VolunteersQualification.description: A catalogue entry. department is absent for an org-wide entry; absent scalar fields read as their zero.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

VolunteersQualificationList.description: The list; items is always present.

VolunteersQualificationInput.description: department is absent for an org-wide entry and must equal the current one on update.

VolunteersRecord.description: A person holds a qualification. verified_at absent = pending (does not count).

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

self_upload.description: Present only on the person's own list: whether uploading a certificate is turned on.

VolunteersRecordList.description: A person's records. self_upload is present only on the actor's own list.

no_expiry.description: true = the record never expires, whatever the catalogue's default validity; with expires_on it is 400 one_of.

VolunteersRecordInput.description: The person comes from the path.

no_expiry.description: true = clear the expiry (the certificate never expires); with expires_on it is 400 one_of.

VolunteersVerifyInput.description: Absent dates keep what the person entered; no_expiry clears the expiry.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

VolunteersPositionList.description: The list; items is always present.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

VolunteersMemberList.description: The list; items is always present.

VolunteersMemberView.description: eligible lists the active positions the person is eligible for today.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

next.description: Pass as after for the next page; absent on the last page.

VolunteersMemberViewList.description: One page of the list; follow next until it is absent.

zone.description: Required for standing work (no event); ignored when event is set.

VolunteersShiftMates.description: Playa names only. Present only on GET /shifts/{shift} and only when the regional's policy shows it to the viewer.

department_name.description: The department's name; absent when the directory does not know it.

VolunteersShiftSummary.description: A shift with the viewer's figures; mates is absent on lists.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

next.description: Pass as after for the next page; absent on the last page.

VolunteersShiftList.description: One page of the list; follow next until it is absent.

legal_name.description: Present only when the regional's legal_name policy shows it to the viewer and people knows one.

VolunteersRosterEntry.description: waived flags a requirement waiver; it outlives waived_by.

VolunteersScheduleEntry.description: id is the sign-up's; shift is the nested shift object.

items.description: Always present; an empty list is [].

next.description: Pass as after for the next page; absent on the last page.

VolunteersScheduleList.description: One page of the list; follow next until it is absent.

VolunteersCertificateUpload.description: multipart/form-data; the text fields come before the file.
